Full summary: v2 eval gate PASSED, no regression: synthetic 0.8909 overall / 100% effective pass rate (March baseline 0.8848) and holdout 0.9937 (baseline 0.9951, noise-level delta), all scorer threshold assertions green on the v2 tree with LLM judges enabled.
Findings: Eval gate detail: synthetic 188/253 checks, worst performers are the intentional negative scenarios (cross-cutting anti-pattern combo 0.58, decide fire-and-forget 0.62, orient-skips-assemble 0.65) — same shape as baseline, expected negatives counted correctly. Holdout 76/78 checks. Caveat stands: comparison is vs the 2026-03-02 baseline (plugin 1.1.3 era) because no 1.23-era baseline was captured; scenario/check counts have evolved since (253 checks now vs 281 then).
